// Browse, reserve, return, admin overview (PRD's critical journeys, minus sign-in which platform/auth owns).
import type { FastifyInstance } from "fastify";
import type { ZodTypeProvider } from "fastify-type-provider-zod";
import { z } from "zod";
import { AdminLoanResponse, ItemResponse, LoanResponse, Page, PageQuery } from "../../../../shared/schemas.ts";
import { errorResponses, mutationSecurity, sessionSecurity } from "../../platform/openapi.ts";
import { requireActor } from "../../platform/actor.ts";
import { memberListLoans, adminListLoans, browseItems, reserveItem, returnItem } from "./service.ts";

export function registerLoanRoutes(app: FastifyInstance): void {
  const r = app.withTypeProvider<ZodTypeProvider>();

  r.get("/api/items", { schema: { security: sessionSecurity, querystring: PageQuery, response: { 200: Page(ItemResponse), ...errorResponses } } }, async (req) => {
    requireActor(req);
    const { limit, offset } = req.query;
    return browseItems(app.db, limit, offset);
  });

  r.get("/api/loans", { schema: { security: sessionSecurity, querystring: PageQuery, response: { 200: Page(LoanResponse), ...errorResponses } } }, async (req) => {
    const actor = requireActor(req);
    const { limit, offset } = req.query;
    return memberListLoans(app.db, actor, limit, offset);
  });

  r.post("/api/items/:id/reserve", { schema: { security: mutationSecurity, params: z.object({ id: z.string() }), response: { 200: LoanResponse, ...errorResponses } } }, async (req) => {
    const actor = requireActor(req);
    return reserveItem(app.db, actor, req.params.id, app.now());
  });

  r.post("/api/loans/:id/return", { schema: { security: mutationSecurity, params: z.object({ id: z.string() }), response: { 200: LoanResponse, ...errorResponses } } }, async (req) => {
    const actor = requireActor(req);
    return returnItem(app.db, actor, req.params.id, app.now());
  });

  r.get("/api/admin/loans", { schema: { description: "Admin only: borrower identity and loan history.", security: sessionSecurity, querystring: PageQuery, response: { 200: Page(AdminLoanResponse), ...errorResponses } } }, async (req) => {
    const actor = requireActor(req);
    const { limit, offset } = req.query;
    return adminListLoans(app.db, actor, limit, offset);
  });
}
